text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The coveted Grand Mile. I've accumulated all the victories necessary to be named the Ruler of the Mile!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A junior-year G1 mile, the Oka Sho, the NHK Mile Cup, the Mile Championship, the February Stakes, the Victoria Mile, and the Yasuda Kinen—all seven are mine!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm the Ruler of the Mile and the All-Rounder. Has my character derailed?! …Aaand, that worry has passed as quickly as it came.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: This achievement is my chance to talk to many other Umamusume I only had the most superficial links to before… This is my link to the whole world!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I am the Ruler of the Mile! I'm gonna keep this up and dominate all distances!
